name: Crowder-Messersmith Conservation Fund
summary: Small seed grants for local conservation and education projects in developing countries. The fund supports communities and individuals whose projects have not attracted major support elsewhere.

eligibility.rule: The project benefits endangered or threatened species or habitat.
The project includes a public education component.
The project involves the local population.
The project is completed within a year.
The project is not pure scientific research or data gathering without an obvious conservation or education benefit.
The project does not focus on species listed as Least Concern in the IUCN Red Book of Threatened Species.
Project takes place outside conflict zones and countries under US banking sanctions

after_award.quote: The Grantee must also agree to provide a project status report 6 months after the project start date. Upon completion of the project, but no later than 12 months, a full project report is required unless an extension is requested due to unforeseen circumstances.
